description: You are executor of your late aunt Margaret's estate and must prepare an inventory for probate court. Open /home/ga/Documents/estate_documents.txt which contains messy financial records. Create a professional spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Estate_Inventory.xlsx with organized sections for ASSETS (bank accounts, investments, real property, vehicles, personal property), LIABILITIES (mortgage, debts), and formulas calculating Total Assets, Total Liabilities, and Net Estate Value. All values must be extracted from the source document and calculations must use formulas, not hard-coded values. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
